notes.title: This Week's Update! New skills and the major adjustments for power users!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing MISTROGUE as always! Here's rather big update for those who challenges the "Ultimate BattleRoads" :) 

[h1]Game System Changes[/h1]

- [u][b]The skill buff duration has been changed: When removing or changing equipment, the buffs triggered by active skills attached to that equipment are reset.[/b][/u]

Previously, buffs generated by the previous equipment were maintained when removing or changing equipment. However, this allowed players to apply more buffs than the intended limit for each equipment, which disrupted game balance. Therefore, the buffs from the previous equipment will now disappear when changing equipment.

- The Leaderboard for the "Ultimate Battleroads" has been reset due to skill additions and adjustments.

[h1]New Skills[/h1]

- Active Skill: Final Cleave
- Passive Skill: Light of Exorcism

[h1]New Items[/h1]

- New Item: Skill Scroll for SR Final Cleave (Weapon)
- New Item: UC Armlet of Exorcism
- New Item: Skill Scroll of Light of Exorcism (Shield)
- New Item: Skill Scroll of Light of Exorcism (Bracelet)

[h1]Content Changes[/h1]

- The attack power and level of the boss on the first floor and the monsters on the second floor of the "The Second Battleroad" have been downwardly adjusted.
- The floor structure of the second floor of the "The Second Battleroad" and the fifth floor of the "Ultimate Battleroad" has been changed to have portals appear after defeating the enemies.
- The boss spawn time and portal stone spawn time on each floor of the "BattleRoads" have been adjusted.

[h1]Item Adjustments[/h1]

- The base defense power of the SSR Diamond Shield has been changed from 9 to 14.
- The base defense power of the SSR Great Instrument Shield has been changed from 7 to 9.

[h1]Skill Adjustments[/h1]

- The attack power increase effect of Overpower has been changed from 30% to 30 (fixed value), and the recast time has been changed from 45 seconds to 60 seconds.
- The defense power increase effect of Iron Body has been changed from 30% to 30 (fixed value), and the recast time has been changed from 45 seconds to 60 seconds.
- The critical rate increase effect of Concentration has been changed from 30% to 35%, and the recast time has been changed from 45 seconds to 60 seconds.
- The speed increase effect of Haste has been changed from 25% to 30%, and the recast time has been changed from 45 seconds to 60 seconds.
- The damage reduction effect of Shield Wall has been changed from 30% to 40%, and the recast time has been changed from 45 seconds to 60 seconds.
- The MP cost of Sprint has been changed from 3 to 4, and the duration has been changed from 7 seconds to 8 seconds.
- The Heroic Blow effect now adds "Increases power by 40 when Hero Stance is active."
- The recast time of Blood Surge has been changed from 15 seconds to 20 seconds.
- The additional power per layer of Poison Break has been changed from 80 to 60, and "The power of this technique will not exceed 400." has been added.
- The occurrence probability of Hardship's Follow-up has been changed from 13% to 18%.
- The occurrence probability of Thousand Needles' Follow-up has been changed from 25% to 35%, and the damage limit has been changed from 310 to 210.
- The defense power increase value of Unbreakable has been changed from 300% to 400%.
- The power of Sonic Leap has been changed from 30 to 40.

Due to the exponential increase in attack power through multiple stacking of Overpower, the game balance, especially in the Hundred Battles Training Ultimate Path, was greatly disrupted. Therefore, adjustments have been made to achieve a suitable balance.

notes.title: Weekly fixes - the Player respawn position, tiny invincible state while dodging
notes.content:
Thx so much for playing MISTROGUE :) We've pushed an update / fix to our game last night!


[h2]System and Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] After the player falls in the dungeon, the restart position is adjusted so that it's less likely to be spawned in the moving tiles (though not 100% eliminated, most of the cases you're safe)
[*] When the player dodges, there's a tiny amount of invincible frames so that it's easier to dodge. If you want more "dodge and attack" play style, we'd still recommend using Dark Speed Blade!
[*] The HP of the boss on the 50th floor of the Endless Hyperspace has been adjusted.
[*] Considering the clear rate of the Feril Ruins and the fact that Assassin Cats have posed a challenge for many players, some enemies encountered in the latter part of the Feril Ruins (Assassin Cats, Bats, Green Priests) have been weakened (reduced damage and attack speed).
[/list]

[h2]Skill Rebalancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] The MP cost of "Destroy" has been changed from 10 to 8. A description error has been corrected.
[/list]

We'll keep bringing these bug fixes in coming days, and we really really appreciate your feedback everyday. See you soon :)

notes.title: Hot Fixes Applied!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing MISTROGUE! We've received overwhelming amount of players, and we're addressing the bug reports and incompatible issues one by one.

So far, we've fixed:

1. There were issues when the players from Mainland China access the game, the Unity SDK API interfered with its geolocation, resulting in the loading screen never progresses over 90%. It's now fully fixed.

2. There were reports of players with M1 Mac (and probably with Win Arm chips) whose installed game immediately crashes due to the memory bad access. Win is fully fixed, but Mac build is still limited without some of Title screen capabilities. We're working to build for Mac to resume its full Title screen capability.

3. Some pads won't be recognized as we only support the XInput mode for Windows build. Before we'll add support for DirectInput mode pads, please refer to some external libraries such as "Xbox 360 Controller Emulator" to make your DirectInput only pad to XInput mode.

4. Some areas of HUD (In Battle) UI were not registered to trigger the normal attack, resulting in the attack won't work sometimes. We've removed the raycast for these boxes, now clicking the minimap or similar areas will not block the normal attack.

We'll keep adding to the list of fixes over the course of week, stay tuned! Again, thank you so much for all of your support for the game.

notes.title: Full Release Launched today: 35% discount Launch Sale for 7 days!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[h2]Full Release has been launched![/h2]
"MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons" is now "Full Release" version! To celebrate its launch, we are having a 35% off special sale for a week from October 27th to November 2nd. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/834ddc6f53f12503dca84c919b61138ff24e2082.png[/img]

The official version contains two major added content - the “Battle Road” challenge and “Skill Book” quest, with over 20 items and 15 skills added. In Addition, the camera can now be freely rotated, and the equipment loot comes with random bonus effects.

We will continue to improve on the game, fixing bugs and tweaking skills here and there. Apart from that, we hope you will give us your feedback so we can create better content for an improved experience. We are also working on a Nintendo Switch version! We hope you'll enjoy "MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons"!

[h2]Pricing[/h2]
We have reduced the price in August, which is a substantial price cut compared to the Early Access version. This was after receiving feedback who played our game in the Early Access version. We hope the price change will allow more people to enjoy the game, ultimately creating a long-term development support of the game.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[h3]The Battle Road[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/857b4fdbe43ce754c1e26d74cafdddbcce045fc1.png[/img]

A challenging boss rush dungeon[b] “The Battle Road” [/b]has been added to the game. Arm yourself with the best equipment as you can, because as you make progress through each stage it will only get harder! There are a total of 5 stages to beat: 
[list]
[*]First Battle Road
[*]Second Battle Road
[*]Third Battle Road
[*]Fourth Battle Road
[*]Ultimate Battle Road
[/list]

To start the First Battle Road, players must challenge the “Endless Hyperspace” and return to Lootgar.
In Lootgar, there is a scoreboard for the final Ultimate Battle Road stage, where players can compete how fast they clear the Battle Road.

[h3]Skill Book[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/48fd2e051c818e45a1d5e0c72ec187bcca00e340.png[/img]

The new feature[b] “Skill Book” [/b] quest is an ultimate guidebook for players to start "Skill Build" journey.

The Skill Book contains "support quests", which will give you necessary equipments to assemble skills with [b]synergies[/b]. To achieve the quests, you'll need to hunt certain types of enemies.

Each Skill Build (called Skill Sets) will also have "levels"; as you make progress in the Skill Build, there are more Skill Synergies unlocked.

The Skill Book can be obtained after having entered the Living Dungeon once and talking to Rex in Lootgar. 

[h3]System[/h3]
[list]
[*]Bonus skills and bonus empty slots are randomly added to weapons, shields, and bracelets. There is a chance bonus skill slots will be added to dropped items, and equipment with bonus skills will be listed with an “EX” before their name. Bonus skills differ per item.
[*]Equipment skills can be reset now. Resetting will make the skill slots you attached with Skill Books to empty. Resetting can be done through the sub menu for equipment inventory. 
[*]MP cost and recast times for skills that have a hitbox are now counted not at the time of selection, but at the timing when the skill hits.
[*]Adjustments have been made to Lupo’s inventory, both in dungeons and Lootgar.
[*]The boss floors in the Endless Hyperspace are fixed and will not fall.
[*]The scoreboard for the Endless Hyperspace is reset.
[*]The camera can now be rotated. （Gamepad：R stick, Keyboard: Z/X keys） Pressing down the R stick on a gamepad or pressing X and Z together on a keyboard will make the camera angel swivel to the back. 
[*]Rewards have been added for clearing the “Maze of Mist”. 
[*]Continuous damage caused by effects such as “Poison” and “Burn” are now immune to damage reduction skills such as “Block”, “Protection”, “Guardian’s Blessing”. 
[*]Staff credit rolls do not start after clearing the “Maze of Mist” but can be accessed from the title screen instead. 
[*]Player MP capacity in normal mode for Lv.1 has increased from 10 to 20, and required exp for leveling has been adjusted.
[*]Changes are made to when the Endless Hyperspace is unlocked.
[*]The dungeon map is now displayed with Mist in the center.
[/list]

[h3]Changes made to items and skills[/h3]
[list]
[*]The active skill “Flame Blade” has a Burn percentage of 13% instead of 10%.
[*]Recast time for the active skill “Blood Surge” has been shortened to 15 secs instead of 30 secs.
[*]The active skills “Double Stab”, “Triple Stab” and “Savage Stab” have a force of 30 instead of 25.
[*]The active skill “Eruption” is now triggered at a faster pace.
[*]The active skill “Blade Storm” has a force of 100 instead of 90.
[*]The active skill “Wind Cutter” uses MP2 instead of 0 and has a force of 60 instead of 50. 
[*]Changes made to the active skill “Ignition” 
　Old: Costs 5 MP. Deals damage with a force of 70 to surrounding enemies. Deals critical damage equal to the remaining Burn damage yet to be dealt to a Burned target. Removes Burn state once damage is dealt.
　New: Costs 5 MP. Deals damage with a force of 70 to surrounding enemies. Deals critical damage equal to the remaining Burn damage yet to be dealt to a Burned target and increases damage by 60%. Removes Burn state once damage is dealt.
[*]Changes made to the active skill “Poison Break”
　Old： Deals damage with a force of 40 to all surrounding enemies. Increases 100% damage to poisoned enemies per stack of Poison. Removes Poison status once damage is dealt.
　New：Deals damage with a force of 40 to all surrounding enemies. Adds additional 80 force to poisoned enemies per stack of Poison. Removes Poison status once damage is dealt.
[*]Changes made to the active skill “Dragonfall” 
　Old: Deals damage with a force of 55 to all surrounding enemies. Increases 100% damage to enemies with over 80% remaining HP. 
　New：Deals damage with a force of 80 to all surrounding enemies. Increases 50% damage to enemies with over 80% remaining HP.
[*]Changes made to the active skill “Destroy”
　Old：Costs 8 MP. Deals damage to all enemies in front with a force of 160. Increases 100% damage to enemies with over 80% remaining HP. 
　New： Costs 8 MP. Deal damage to all enemies in front with a force of 240. Increases 100% damage to enemies with over 50% remaining HP. 
[*]Passive skill “Time Compression” is not stackable anymore. 
[*]Effects for UC item “Immunity Potion” has been shortened from 30 secs to 15 secs.
[*]Changed rarity of equipment “Sprint Bracelet” from R to UC. 
[*]Reduced empty slots for UC equipment “Crystal Shield” from 2 to 1. 
[*]Changed UC equipment name “Speed Bracelet” to “Sprint Bracelet”. 
[*]Changed the force of R item “Explosion” Skill Scroll from 350 to 380.
[*]Added unique skill “Slash” to R rank equipment “Wind Blade” and reduced its empty slots from 2 to 1. 
[*]Changed equipment “Knight Shield” rarity from UC to R, and its defense to 5. Empty slots are reduced from 2 to 1, and pricing has changed to 2800 Gold. 
[*]Unique skill for SR equipment “Flame Shield” has changed from “Heat Skin” to “Flame Wall”. 
[*]Deleted SR item “Invisible Skill Scroll”. Those who have used it on a slot will have their slots emptied, and all Invisible Skill Scrolls in the warehouse and inventory will be deleted. 
[/list]

The changes made to the skills are adjustments made for the new content ”Battle Road”. They are applied so it is easier to fight against solo bosses and increase versatility to skill builds. 
Notably, the explosive damage in “Poison Break”, the stackable buffs for “Time Compression” (also in “Invincible”, “Hero Stance” and “Blood Spiller” etc.), and the ability to continuously use “Invincible” proved to disrupt the games balance when it came to time attack challenges and rankings. Changes have been made to maintain difficulty levels within the challenge.

[h3]New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] UC item “Poison Sword”

notes.title: "MISTROGUE" Official Release Scheduled for October 2023!
notes.content:
The official release of "MISTROGUE" is set for October. In the upcoming savage content, "The Battle Road", new formidable enemies await in front of Mist, promising even more intense battles. To conquer these formidable foes and reach the deepest levels, players will need to utilize the guidance provided by the "Skill Book," and the replayability of the game will be significantly enhanced. Enjoy the unique experience of overwhelming powerful enemies through skill synergy.

[h2]Engage in relentless battles against tough enemies in the ultra-challenging boss rush mode, "The Battle Road"[/h2]

[previewyoutube=j_gHA3EBv-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

After completing the story, venture into a new stage with your finely-tuned skill build. This is the endgame content known as "The Battle Road". It features a boss rush mode where formidable foes appear one after another on battle-specific floors, and players must defeat them within a set time limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/e12f88e7cfc51ce5027d311a059c3987e4c6649f.png[/img]

"The Battle Road" consists of five layers, with each layer leading to the next upon completion. Players can bring their equipment and items with them, and only consumable item chests will spawn inside. There's no risk of losing your gear even if you fail. While success requires action skills, it's equally important to use skill builds and items strategically based on the situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/e4a0d80483b05b919bf0e0dd08214f3e52df6fb4.png[/img]

The leaderboards will display the highest floor reached and the completion time for each attempt, allowing players to compete with others. Also, stay tuned for the final boss character on the last floor of "The Battle Road".

[h2]A Trusty Companion for Skill Building - "Skill Book"[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/a5c7beacdae9afe2f6b3954a3488e04f18f7d99d.png[/img]

The new feature, "Skill Book," serves as a handy guide that automatically helps you construct your skill build as you progress through elimination quests. It provides concrete guidance on how to maximize synergy by combining skills to "overwhelm powerful enemies."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/7a4ebb7d255c81e383562e27d58a8159770e0e11.png[/img]

The "Skill Book" handed to you by Rex in the city of Lootgar, contains recommended skill sets (skill builds) in advance. It clearly shows which skills are needed to complete the build and which equipment they are attached to. Elimination quests, such as "Defeat 15 Red Dragons. Reward: Blazing Fire Blade," are also available to acquire skills (equipment) you don't already possess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/241f5ff68643faa87869aef52fe784fe1ecc4d80.png[/img]

Of course, the skill sets (skill builds) mentioned in this skill book are not the only options, and you can create your own unique skill build. Make sure to utilize the Skill Book as your ally in conquering the challenges.

Please stay tuned for the official release!
[b]*The image is in Japanese, but it is planned to be available in English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), and Korean upon the official release.[/b]

notes.title: 2023 JULY UPDATE!
notes.content:
Thank you always for playing "MISTROGUE"!

In this update, we mainly made the following two points:

[h1]1. Improvement of Endless Hyperspace[/h1]

[list]
[*] For players who play "MISTROGUE", especially "Endless Hyperspace", to its ultimate challenges, we have changed the enemy's level cap from 50 to 100. We also changed the level status cap of the mist from 30 to 50.
[*] [u][b]As a result of releasing the enemy's level cap and changing the level cap of the mist to 50, we have segmented the leaderboard of the end content "Endless Hyperspace" before and after the update.[/b][/u]
[*] To allow more people to play "Endless Hyperspace", we made it possible to challenge the Hyperspace after clearing the "Living Cave".
[/list]

[h1]2. Making skill builds easier to understand[/h1]
[list]
[*] To make it easier to understand status increases in "Skill Build", we set the top left of the battle screen as the status panel display position.
[*] We changed the tutorial at the start of the game to be compact, and more emphasis on telling the "Skill Build" effects.
[/list]

Please enjoy the updated version of "MISTROGUE" early access!

[h2]GAME SYSTEM[/h2]

[list]
[*] We have changed the enemy's level cap from 50 to 100.
[*] The status of Mist will now increase even after level 30.
[*] We changed the curve of status changes from level 30 to level 50 of the mist (so that the status will increase even after level 30).
[*] The end content "Endless Hyperspace" has been opened after clearing the "Living Cave" and has become challengeable.
[*] As a result of releasing the enemy's level cap and changing the level cap of the mist to 50, we have renewed the leaderboard of the end content "Endless Hyperspace".
[*] We have completely renewed the "Tutorial" that starts at the first launch.
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]

[list]
[*] Equipment screen: When you hover over each equipment, you can now check the details of the attached skills.
[*] Battle screen: The equipment list in the upper left has been deleted, and instead, the status values of the mist and the correction values due to equipment and skills are now displayed.
[*] On the left passive skill column, the active ones are highlighted and the inactive ones are grayed out.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update! New contents "Endless Hyperspace" and "Memory Treasure" are out!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing MISTROGUE.

This patch is the largest patch since Early Access began. As mentioned in the roadmap, we received many comments about the lack of content in the Early Access release, so we have added a new dungeon "Endless Hyperspace" with no carry-in, "Memory Treasure" as a base collection element, and a "Dismantle" function to expand the range of skill-building.

Unlike previous dungeons, "Endless Hyperspace" has no floor limit. Along the way, bosses and new character "Lukia" events are waiting, but even after those events are over, the floor will continue to be generated infinitely. You can send the floors you reached before you died to the leaderboard, and you can compete with other players around the world for the floors you reached and the time you reached. You can check the leaderboard from Lootgar.

In "Memory Treasure", defeating enemies and collecting "Memory Fragments" that rarely appear will gather "Memory Treasure" in the newly established gallery in Lootgar. Memory Treasure is a special item with a story related to the world of MISTROGUE.

Along with this update, many new items, new skills, enemies and boss characters have been added. Enjoy the new contents of MISTROGUE!

[h2]New Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*] An infinite subterranean dungeon, "Endless Hyperspace," has been added. Endless Hyperspace is opened by interacting with the new NPC "Lukia" in Lootgar after clearing the[strike] "Maze of Mist"[/strike]"Living Cave". The ranking of the tiers reached can be checked from the "Leaderboard" in Lootgar.
*Endless Hyperscape release condition changed from after clearing "Maze of Mist" to after clearing "Living Cave" (2023/8/1).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/a0252f9b3ebc40bfaa6e0cc6ae00489caf4eaa40.png[/img]
[*]The base element "Memory Treasure" has been added. By picking up "Memory Fragments" randomly dropped by defeating enemies, memory treasures are collected in a newly established gallery in Lootgar. No opening event is required. "Memory Fragments" will be dropped in all dungeons, including "Endless Hyperspace".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/b418fb6549bb2f8881d35930aa9cccb365e253c2.png[/img]
[/list]

[/list]

[h2]New Skill[/h2]

[*]Spirit of Frugality
[*]Time Compression
[/list]

[h2]New System[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to "Dismantle" equipment. You can dismantle equipment to obtain items such as Skill Scrolls. Dismantling can be done from the submenu displayed by right-clicking the equipment item name in the equipment inventory (Y / square button on the pad). notes.title: MISTROGUE roadmap & more to come in 2023!
notes.content:
Hey everyone.

I'm Hiroki Shimada, the producer and director of MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeon. The Early Access version, which was released in April, was played by many people, and we received numerous reviews and feedback. Based on that feedback, we have decided on several updates for the official version, and today I would like to share the roadmap for the currently planned updates.

Please note that the roadmap content (especially the number of items and their timing) may change since we are still in development. Please keep that in mind as you read!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/9bac485bee8b8e588dffe8f5ce400d75f51b4bb7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Early June: Hard mode and other utility features[/h2]

Firstly, in the upcoming update in early June, we have added a new difficulty level called "Hard Mode" and made significant balance adjustments to the Normal Mode. This is in response to the feedback we received in the Early Access version, such as "it's too easy" and "the character  becomes too strong." While the character becoming increasingly powerful is one of the highlights of MISTROGUE, the players had become stronger than we had expected, making the later stages somewhat lacking in challenge. We have made adjustments to balance-breaking skills and modified the stats of enemies and bosses in the Maze of Mist(3rd Dungeon).

Hard Mode has been designed to satisfy veteran roguelike players and hardcore gamers. Not only is the main character weaker against enemies, but death also results in losing a portion of the possessed items (including equipped equipment) and increased penalties from falling. Considering the loss upon death, it will be challenging to clear the game in a few attempts. It will be necessary to steadily accumulate items in the warehouse, resulting in significantly longer playtime compared to Normal Mode. Hard Mode can be selected from the settings screen on the title or Lootgar .

Additionally, we have added camera rotation (Z/X keys for keyboard or L3/R3 for gamepad) and a click aiming setting (changeable from the settings screen) for players using keyboard and mouse. Full-screen mode (already added in May), vibration ON/OFF (changeable from the settings screen), and improvements to the UI interaction in trading and warehouse screens have also been implemented. For more detailed update information, please refer here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/38ce43433020e4183506dc77b7cd9b8411ea88c8.gif[/img]

[h2]Early July: Endless Hyperspace ( New Dungeon) & Memory's Treasure[/h2]

Another feedback we received frequently in the Early Access was the "lack of content." Since it was an Early Access version, the content was limited to story completion. However, in the full release, we plan to add endgame content and base-building features. These updates will be implemented from the end of June to July.

One of these updates is the new dungeon "Endless Hyperspace," which was also suggested on Discord. In the Endless Hyperspace, players cannot bring any items or money, nor can they take items back with them. While there are events in certain layers, there is no upper limit to the floors, allowing for infinite exploration. When you die, you can record the reached floor, elapsed time, and Steam name on the leaderboard if desired, allowing players to compete in terms of reached floors. There might even be new NPCs appearing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/69a15eff125e8db4762a6d1581169abc3d01935e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/7efa387b83014a74fd502f19a9e0b814f3357bde.png[/img]

Another addition is the base-building feature called "Memory's Treasure." By collecting special items dropped in the dungeon, Memory's Treasure will appear in Route Gaul, where you can view stories and original illustrations related to MISTROGUE's characters and world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/94e31a7ef6393ed946b40d41ccf66cb5df35d52d.png[/img]

In addition to these, we are planning features such as the "Decompose" function, which allows you to break down equipment to obtain Skill Scrolls and items, and the addition of new skills and SSR equipment (such as SSR daggers and SSR bracelets).

[h2]Official Version[/h2]
The major updates that have been decided at this point are as mentioned above. However, depending on sales and the feedback received for the June-July updates, updates to the official version may be added. While it has not been confirmed yet, we are also considering publishing the game on console platforms such as Nintendo Switch and PS4. We will provide further information as soon as it is determined!

We greatly appreciate the feedback and reviews on Discord, which serve as valuable references for the direction and content of the updates. We are also eagerly awaiting new item/skill ideas, suggestions on new contents, and so on. So please continue to support MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeon. 

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Major Update: Hard Mode has been added!
notes.content:
This is the first major update since the start of Early Access. As mentioned in the roadmap released today, this update includes a new difficulty mode called "Hard Mode" and significant balance adjustments to the Normal Mode.

These changes reflect the feedback we received during the Early Access version, where players mentioned that the game was "too easy" and the protagonist became "overpowered." While it's intended for the protagonist to become increasingly stronger in MISTROGUE, players were becoming too powerful at the level we had envisioned, resulting in less challenge in the later stages. We have addressed this by balancing skills that were breaking the game's balance and adjusting the stats of enemies and bosses in the Maze of Mist.

In particular, regarding skill adjustments, we focused on resolving the issue of the lack of satisfaction due to being able to defeat strong enemies in the depths of the Maze of Mist with a single blow. We have made changes to normalize passive skills that had significant increases based on percentage increments, including powerful area-of-effect skills, stacking effects, and level-based increments.

The new difficulty mode, "Hard Mode," imposes significant penalties upon death and strengthens stats and time limits for enemies and bosses. This creates a stronger strategic element between retreat and progress, providing a heightened sense of tension. Even if you have played once, I highly recommend starting a new game from the beginning.

[h2]NEW SKILLS[/h2]
The following new skills have been added:
[list]
[*] Protection
[*] Blood Surge
[*] Guardian's Blessing
[/list]

[h2]NEW ITEMS[/h2]
The following new items have been added:
[list]
[*] UC : Immunity Potion
[*] UC : Build Up Potion
[*] SR : Blood Surge Bracelet
[*] SR : Guardian Shield
[*] UC : Protection Skill Scroll
[*] R : Blood Surge Skill Scroll
[*] SR : Guardian's Blessing Skill Scroll
[/list]

[h2]REBALANCING[/h2]
[h3]Skill Effect Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dragonfall: Changed power from 70 to 55 (Correction: There was an incorrect notation stating its power as 90).
[*] Backslash: Changed power from 120 to 100.
[*] Divide: Changed power from 180 to 160.
[*] Heart Strike: Changed power from 90 to 80.
[*] Destroy: Changed MP consumption from 8 to 10.
[*] Heroic Blow: Changed power from 60 to 45.
[*] Will of the Brave: Changed attack power increase from 25% to 10 (fixed value).
[*] Guard of the Brave: Changed defense power increase from 25% to 10 (fixed value).
[*] High Pressure: Changed critical hit rate increase from 20% to 15%.
[*] High Tension: Changed critical hit damage increase from 40% to 30%.
[*] Vitality: Changed attack power increase from 15% to 5 (fixed value).
[*] Irresistible Force: Changed damage dealt from 40% to 30%.
[*] Sonic Leap: Changed power from 35 to 30.
[*] Mana Conversion: Changed attack power increase from 25% to 10 (fixed value).
[*] Eruption: Changed recast time from 15 seconds to 20 seconds.
[*] Block: Changed MP consumption from 5 to 4. Reduced effect duration from 6 seconds to 5 seconds. Increased recast time from 0 seconds to 5 seconds.
[/list]

[h3]Item Effect Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ether: Changed MP recovery amount from 20 to 10.
[*] High Ether: Changed MP recovery amount from 40 to 20.
[*] Poison Spellbook: Changed effect duration from 30 seconds to 25 seconds.
[*] Burn Spellbook: Changed effect duration from 9 seconds to 8 seconds.
[*] Hero Sword: Changed critical damage assist effect from +10% to +5%. Changed critical hit rate assist effect from 10 % to 5%.
[*] Hero Shield: Changed HP assist effect from +10% to +5%.
[/list]

[h3]Other Adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The maximum damage per Burn has been reduced.
[*] The maximum damage per Poison has been reduced.
[*] The amount of EXP required for leveling up has been adjusted.
[*] The increase in attack power and defense power from leveling up has been adjusted.
[*] The trading stock of Lupo at each location has been changed. Skill books such as "Will of the Brave " and “Guard of the Brave” will now appear based on progression, and items such as “Potion of Strength” will be available for sale.
[/list]

[h2]GAME SYSTEM[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new difficulty mode called "Hard Mode" has been added for hardcore players. You can set the difficulty to "Hard" at the start of the game, on the title screen, or from Lootgar at any time. In "Hard" mode, the character stats become weaker against enemies, and dying will result in the loss of some items, including equipment. Bosses' HP, stats, and some enemy stats have been enhanced, and the penalty for falling has increased.
[*] Camera rotation is now possible. You can rotate the camera left and right using the UI buttons displayed at the top of the map, the Z/X keys on the keyboard, or the L3/R3 buttons (pressing the sticks) on the gamepad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42776196/38ce43433020e4183506dc77b7cd9b8411ea88c8.gif[/img]
[*] When a boss is defeated, other summoned monsters will now die as well.
[*] When using the keyboard and mouse, an Aim option (click aim) has been added, where the character will face the direction of the click. You can change this option in the settings menu.
[*] The option to toggle the gamepad vibration ON/OFF has been added to the settings menu.
[*] An opacity effect has been added when characters are hidden behind walls or obstacles.
[*] An effect of shaking platforms has been added when using Remover Maze Stone and Remove Bit.
[/list]

[h2]EVENT[/h2]
[list]
[*] An event has been added that explains the contents of a treasure chest in the tutorial dungeon "Living Cave: Entrance" before it is opened.
[*] An event has been added for the first use of the boss portal.
[*] An event has been added where items are granted by Rex when defeated by the boss on the 3rd floor of the Feril Ruins.
[/list]

[h2]ENEMY[/h2]
[list]
[*] The timing of certain enemies' attack animations and damage occurrence has been adjusted.
[*] The power and stats of some enemies' skills, primarily those appearing in the Misty Dungeon, have been changed.
[*] The HP, stats, and skill effects of the Misty Dungeon bosses have been modified.
[*] The levels of enemies in the Misty Dungeon have increased.
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] A confirmation window is now displayed when selling equipment and skill books.
[*] The display when the warehouse is empty has been changed.
[*] The display when there is not enough money during buying and selling has been corrected.
[/list]

[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]
With the addition of Hard Mode, the following achievements have been added:
[list]
[*] Challenger of Difficulties: Clear the Living Cave in Hard Mode.
[*] Overcomer of Difficulties: Clear the Feril Ruins in Hard Mode.
[*] Breaker of Difficulties: Clear the Misty Dungeon in Hard Mode.
[/list]

[h2]BUGFIX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed various bugs, including the issue of the key guide blinking rapidly when launching external applications.
[/list]

[h2]OTHER[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated 3d model of Mist.
[*] Fixed the issue of excessive volume when overlapping sound effects.
[*] Improved the game performance.
[/list]
